mapper.select: SELECT dm.dept_code, dm.company_code, dm.dept_name, dm.upper_dept_no, dmu.dept_name as upper_dept_name, dm.dept_level, dm.start_date, dm.end_date, ccs.code_name as status, dm.rm FROM tb_dept_master dm JOIN tb_cm_code ccs ON ccs.group_code = '0R' LEFT JOIN tb_dept_master dmu ON dmu.dept_code = dm.upper_dept_no WHERE dm.company_code = #{companyCode} AND dm.status = '0' AND ccs.code = dm.status ORDER BY dmu.dept_name
